issue.title: Give the tool-run settlement notification a real action that opens the settled ToolRun
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-17p.5 (epic sase-17p, E2 durable ToolRun hand-off) as a
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note; filed by the sase-17p land agent on 2026-09-24.

A proc-owned hand-off (`sase tool run -H ...`) publishes exactly one settlement
notification (src/sase/tool/notify.py `deliver_handoff_settlement`: sender `tool-run`,
deterministic uuid5 id over `tool-run-settled:<run_id>`). It is published with
`action=None` and `action_data={"run_id": RUN, "command": "sase tool show RUN"}`,
because no generic "run command" / "open ToolRun" notification action exists and an
unknown action string makes the TUI notification modal warn. So the notification can
say what happened but gives the user no one-key way to open the run; they have to copy
the command out of the body.

Wanted: a real notification action (routed through the shared notification action
dispatcher from sase-16j.1) that opens the settled ToolRun — e.g. prints
`sase tool show RUN` / `sase tool show RUN -l` in a pager, or jumps to a ToolRun detail
view once one exists — and switch `deliver_handoff_settlement` to it. Keep the id
deterministic and the delivery exactly-once; monitor-owned runs must still never notify.

task_type_fields.proposal: A notification action for sender=tool-run that opens the settled ToolRun (sase tool show RUN / -l) from the TUI, replacing action=None in deliver_handoff_settlement.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: E2 (sase-17p) scoped TUI surfaces out (E5 in the sase tool roadmap); the settlement phase could only publish the notification with the command in action_data.
